visual_action: A person uses a heat press machine to apply the word 'SNOWFLAKE' in bold, black, sans-serif letters onto a white sweatshirt. The video ends on a static shot of the completed sweatshirt with animated falling snowflakes and sparkles overlaid.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The narrator says 'We saw Trump moved his inauguration indoors' and on-screen text reads 'Stay warm, Donald'.

cast.name: unnamed person
cast.evidence: The hands and arms of a person are shown operating the machinery to create the sweatshirt.

on_screen_text.text: We saw Trump moved his inauguration indoors
because he can't handle the cold :-[
so we made him a custom sweatshirt

spoken_summary: A narrator with a deep voice states that they saw Donald Trump moved his inauguration indoors because 'he can't handle the cold.' In response, they 'made him a custom sweatshirt, nice and cozy.' The narrator concludes by saying, 'Stay warm, Donald.'
audio_music: The video features only a deep, male voice narrating over the natural sounds of the workshop. There is no music. The narration has a serious, almost dramatic tone that contrasts with the mocking content.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a slow, continuous shot that follows the process of making the sweatshirt, followed by a final static shot of the finished product. The pacing is slow and deliberate.
cultural_references: The term 'snowflake' used as a political insult, typically by conservatives against liberals, is here used against a conservative figure, Donald Trump.
central_claim: Donald Trump is weak and unable to handle the cold, making him a 'snowflake' for moving his inauguration indoors.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump, portray him as weak and hypocritical, and amuse the audience.
